GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Not Bustled back 2nd last Two Wide 9 Lengths 1000m, started to creep into the race Wide before the corner, widest Straightening Up , let down from the 200m and showed impressive turn-of-hoof, drove to the front soon after and held margin for big win from the back # big win from back
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down 2nd last 8 Lengths 1200m 8th 10 Lengths 800m 9th 8 Lengths home turn Hooked Out 3 Wide 7th widest runner Straight ran on final 200m # back/ran on/ready
Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 2nd last 7 Lengths 800m, weaved a passage from the back Straightening Up , came off heels last 100m and battled on well to be Just out of placings # not far away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in behind runners from a wide barrier. Raced fiercely during the middle stages. Held up in the early part of the straight and near the 150m was steadied and shifted across heels to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, Eased & Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , improved a length to be running 8th of 8 trailing 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, moved through to 3rd place in Straight but a distance from 1-2. # distant 3rd place
Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down 8th fence 6 Lengths 800m 2nd last 7 Lengths home turn 7th rail took inside run Straight held up 250m Checked 150m # no luck str/forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and checked from heels. Obtained narrow run to inside of another runner in straight. Bumped that runner near 150m and was checked before obtaining clear running inside final 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 8 Lengths Two Wide , made no ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 8 Lengths Four Wide , steered widest Straightening Up and Made Good Ground down the outside in Straight # Did Best Work Late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m was steadied after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down drifted back to last 8 lengths. last turn. Held Ground # Never Likely
Slow Out 2 lengths Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn 6 lengths. ran on strongly late # start costly
Bit Slow Out 1-2 Lengths bustled, gave ground quickly, settled clear last, never sighted # tardy/never in it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jockey reported that this mount, which was tailed off throughout the event, was uncomfortable in its action and failed to respond to his riding. A post-race veterinary examination revealed Birdy Girl to be lame (2/5) in the off-hind. Stable representative was advised that a veterinary clearance is required prior to the mare barrier trialling to the Stewards’ satisfaction. Vet/ trial passed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , overraced last rails 6 Lengths 800m, stayed hard on fence soon after Straightening Up , Made Good Ground and grabbed minor placing, bubble cheeker (off side) first time # rail hugging place
Bit Slow Out 1 length settled back 5l off, improved Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, worked home well making good ground without threatening # back/home ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid in under pressure during the straight and near the 50m was corrected after laying in towards heels. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
